import { Component, inject, signal, output } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { ExportImportDataService, B2bProduct } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-public-home', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
K
KEYA GROUP GLOBAL TRADE HUB

100% Export Oriented Textile, Garment & Chemical Industrial Complex

🌐 Bangladesh Premier Garments & Textiles Exporter

Global B2B Sourcing Platform & Direct Exporter

Keya Group is a fully integrated industrial conglomerate manufacturing 100% export quality knitwear garments, combed cotton yarn, raw cotton bales, and personal care cosmetics for international buyers worldwide.

Annual Outbound Export
$220 Million+
Monthly Garment Output
4.5M Pcs
Global Destination Markets
35+ Countries
🔍
Group Infrastructure

Keya Industrial Divisions

Vertically integrated manufacturing facilities supplying global buyers.

100% EXPORT APPAREL

Keya Knit Composite Ltd.

Est. 1996

Vertical composite apparel manufacturing T-Shirts, Polo Shirts, Fleece Hoodies, and Sweatpants.

Monthly Capacity: 4.5M Garments Export: $120M/Year
RING SPUN YARN MILLS

Keya Spinning Mills Ltd.

Est. 2003

Precision ring spun combed and carded cotton yarns (Ne 20/1 to 80/1) tested to Uster Top 5% benchmark.

Monthly Capacity: 3,800 MT Yarn Export: $45M/Year
PERSONAL CARE & SOAP

Keya Cosmetics & Toiletries

Est. 1990

Global exporter of beauty soaps, glycerine, toothpaste, petroleum jelly, and laundry detergents.

Monthly Capacity: 12,000 MT Soap Export: $30M/Year
RAW MATERIAL SUPPLY

Keya Cotton & Fiber Supply

Est. 2005

International raw cotton import procurement hub sourcing Australian Pima and US raw cotton bales.

Monthly Capacity: 5,000 Bales Cotton Import/Export: $25M/Year
Product Showcase

Featured B2B Export Products

Showing {{ dataService.filteredB2bProducts().length }} Certified Export Products
@for (prd of dataService.filteredB2bProducts(); track prd.id) {
HS: {{ prd.hsCode }}
{{ prd.sellerVerificationTier }}

{{ prd.title }}

Manufacturer: {{ prd.sellerName }}

FOB Price:{{ prd.fobPriceRange }}
Min. Order:{{ prd.moq }}
}
Buyer Sourcing Board

Active International Buy Leads (RFQs)

@for (lead of dataService.buyLeads(); track lead.id) {
{{ lead.leadCode }} {{ dataService.formatValue(lead.targetUnitPriceUSD) }} / Unit

{{ lead.title }}

Buyer: {{ lead.buyerName }} (🌐 {{ lead.destinationCountry }})
Qty: {{ lead.quantityNeeded }}

{{ lead.specifications }}

}
Logistics Suite

Container Freight Load Calculator

Total Calculated Volume:
{{ getCalcCbm().toFixed(2) }} CBM
40FT HC Container Utilization: {{ (getCalcCbm() / 76.4 * 100).toFixed(1) }}%
@if (showPostRfqModal()) {

Post Custom Buy Requirement (RFQ)

} @if (showInquiryModal()) {

Send Direct Trade Inquiry

}
` }) export class PublicHomeComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); onOpenAdmin = output(); showPostRfqModal = signal(false); showInquiryModal = signal(false); selectedProductForInquiry = signal(null); // RFQ Form newLeadTitle = ''; newLeadQty = ''; newLeadCountry = ''; // Inquiry Form inquiryName = ''; inquiryEmail = ''; inquiryMessage = ''; // Calc Form calcQty = 800; calcL = 60; calcW = 40; calcH = 40; getCalcCbm(): number { return (this.calcL * this.calcW * this.calcH * this.calcQty) / 1000000; } scrollToSection(id: string) { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } openInquiryModal(product: B2bProduct) { this.selectedProductForInquiry.set(product); this.showInquiryModal.set(true); } submitBuyLead() { if (!this.newLeadTitle) return; this.dataService.postBuyLead({ title: this.newLeadTitle, quantityNeeded: this.newLeadQty || '10,000 Pcs', destinationCountry: this.newLeadCountry || 'Germany' }); this.showPostRfqModal.set(false); this.newLeadTitle = ''; } submitInquiry() { if (!this.inquiryMessage) return; this.dataService.sendInquiry({ subject: `Inquiry for ${this.selectedProductForInquiry()?.title || 'Product'}`, message: this.inquiryMessage, senderName: this.inquiryName || 'Buyer Representative', senderEmail: this.inquiryEmail || 'buyer@trade.com' }); this.showInquiryModal.set(false); this.inquiryMessage = ''; } }
